name: Loveland (Ohio, United States)
description: Divided diagonally white over blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with a red heart bearing 1796 in yellow, topped by green leaves, over a red scroll reading LOVELAND.
history: Loveland is a city in Hamilton, Clermont and Warren counties in southwestern Ohio. Wikidata dates the heart flag from 27 August 1974 to 1 December 2025, when the city announced its successor, "The Heart Land" by local artist Arianna Wilson, to be unveiled at the sesquicentennial celebrations in 2026.
